text.title: Effective numerical gains
text.hint: Equipment-only preview; the server is authoritative. Bulwark reduction only benefits Guardians.
text.columns: Stat: raw / effective / capped excess; then effective change
text.unsupported: Red unique affixes are not available; this panel does not estimate them.

cap_text.not_applicable: Not applicable to this class (not capped excess)
cap_text.resistance_stage: Element resistance is capped at 60%; excess adds no effective resistance.
cap_text.draw_stage: This panel shows equipment-only draw intervals. Combat combines equipment and temporary speed, then clamps to 1.8–6 seconds. PVE draw-block conversion halves the interval after that clamp and expires normally.
cap_text.shield_stage: Shield is capped at half the class base health. Requested, effective and overflow shield are counted separately.

guardian_rules: Remainder accumulates deterministically in tenths, without a random trigger. Only a successful play updates it; previews, duplicate requests and rejected actions do not add remainder.
An already full shield or a card with zero shield keeps the remainder. A successful play that exactly fills or exceeds the shield cap clears it.
Leaving the current cell clears both shield and remainder.

guardian_impact.title: Extra weapon shield: each level
guardian_impact.columns: Weapon level | Current steps | Fractional mean | Change
guardian_impact.warning: Levels +2 and +4 have lower mean extra weapon shield. The gain at +1 does not offset those declines.
guardian_impact.scope: Weapon bonus means only. Health, card rounding and the shield cap affect usable shield; this does not imply better survival at every level.
